purpose: Define secrets as explicit logical identities whose secret values are separate protected material and never embedded into canonical semantic identifiers.

topics.name: Secret Identity
topics.purpose: Define secrets as explicit logical identities whose secret values are separate protected material and never embedded into canonical semantic identifiers.

semantics.identity_rule: Each secret has a stable logical secret identity.
semantics.value_rule: Secret value/material is separate from identity/metadata.
semantics.storage_rule: Physical secret-store location is a binding only.
semantics.redaction_rule: Secret values are never included in ordinary canonical JSON, logs or monitors.
semantics.authority_rule: Secret metadata visibility does not grant secret-value access.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: secret stored inline in ordinary canonical contract
